Thanks, Nadia. I'll keep this between us. I won't pass the Vantorre Albany news or the Bluefin codename to anyone, Ruth included.

Is there anything you want me to do with it? If you think Ruth should be briefed, that's a call for you or Mateo to make. I can draft a note to her for you to review, but I won't send anything without your go-ahead.
